name: hcportal_deleteEvent
description: Soft-deletes a run by setting HC.Event.removed = 1 and updatedAt = GETDATE(), but only if no hasher is checked in (HC.HasherEventMap.AttendenceState >= 20, counted under HOLDLOCK in the same transaction as the UPDATE). Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicEventId as the callerParamString. Gate: the caller's HasherKennelMap row for the run's kennel must carry AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081 (superAdmin | authIsAdmin); otherwise it answers 'Event not found.' so the run's existence is not revealed. Returns a plain Result string after validation — callers must read its text to tell success from a blocked delete.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Auth: device ID used to look up the authenticated user and device secret. Validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Auth: short-lived cryptographic token, validated via HC6.ValidatePortalAuth with @publicEventId as the context identifier.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: Required: identifies the event to soft-delete. Changed from NVARCHAR(250) in HC5 to UNIQUEIDENTIFIER. Validated for NULL after auth check.

rowsets.name: ErrorEnvelope
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure, NULL publicEventId, run not found, caller lacks admin flags ('Event not found.'), or runtime error (CATCH, ERROR_MESSAGE()). Short-circuits on the first error.

rowsets.name: DeletionResult
rowsets.description: Returned after validation passes (event found). Single row. Returned for both successful deletion and blocked deletion — callers must read the Result string to determine outcome.

columns.name: Result
columns.description: Outcome message. 'This run has been successfully removed' on success. 'Cannot delete this run because N Hasher(s) have been checked in to the run.' when AttendenceState >= 20 for one or more attendees. 'Event not found or already removed' if @@ROWCOUNT=0 after UPDATE (concurrent deletion edge case).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.Event SET removed=1, updatedAt=GETDATE() WHERE id=@eventId — only when @countAtHash = 0 (no checked-in attendees)
breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change the AttendenceState >= 20 threshold without coordinating with the portal client
Never change the Result message strings without coordinating with callers that parse them

codeSmells.issue: CATCH does not log to HC.ErrorLog
codeSmells.detail: Lines 126-129: the CATCH rolls back and returns ERROR_MESSAGE() but writes no HC.ErrorLog row (the header says logging moved to the API shim), so a runtime failure has no server-side record.

codeSmells.issue: Two rowset shapes for one call
codeSmells.detail: Errors return {Success, ErrorMessage} (lines 45-80, 128); every post-validation outcome returns {Result} (lines 103-121), and success vs blocked is only distinguishable by parsing the text.

Line 60 resolves the run without removed = 0 / deleted = 0 and the UPDATE at line 95 has no removed = 0 predicate, so re-deleting a removed run reports success and bumps updatedAt; the @@ROWCOUNT = 0 branch (line 100) is effectively unreachable.
Lines 72-81 test raw AppAccessFlags & 0x40000081 rather than HC6.CheckKennelPermission, so mismanagement-role grantors on HasherKennelMap cannot delete a run here even where they may edit it.
Line 96 writes GETDATE() (server-local, no offset) to HC.Event.updatedAt DATETIMEOFFSET(7); correct only while the server clock is UTC.
